title: Dual-regioselective direct C(sp2)-arylation of unprotected β-enamino esters with 2-indolylmethanols catalyzed by Brønsted acid
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05581D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qing-Chun Song, Pei-Hua Zhao, Yu-Xi Xing, Chen-Xin Bao, Ling-Yan Chen, Ya Li
An dual-regioselective strategy has been developed for the direct C(sp2)-arylation of β-enamino esters with 2-indolylmethanols, delivering 48 structurally diverse indole-enamino ester hybrids in moderate to excellent yields (up to 98%).
